changes: Reduced header height and page top padding.
Kept mobile header in one row with a shorter mobile nav label.
Preserved focus-visible styles and Indigo Paper tokens.
Expanded the homepage from a placeholder-feeling intro into a concise public library entry point.
Added a printing-first section that mentions the future online coloring workspace without implementing or overpromising it.
Reworked CTA and section copy to sound more direct and human.
Limited the preview gallery from 48 items to 12 items.
Tightened browsing hierarchy across popular, seasonal, subject, style, and preview sections.
Documented the generated route substitutions for adult detailed pages and kids pages.
Removed parent-only navigation blocks that created sparse gaps.
Kept child hub navigation only when it adds useful browsing depth.
Improved hub intro wording for standard, kids, and detailed adult collections.
Deduped section term lists before rendering them.
Moved asset URL resolution into server-rendered callers while keeping the resolver centralized.
Used media fallback content so unavailable assets display clean placeholders.
Kept Download PNG, Download SVG, and Print support without exposing local filesystem paths.
Shortened visible card action labels to PNG, SVG, and Print while preserving download aria labels.
Reduced and deduped filter chips.
Added durable browser visual QA rules.
Added deterministic Round 4D visual/design guardrail tests.
Included the Round 4D test in npm test.
